checks.method: Read the pinned repository paper/main.tex lines 188-350 and 443-636; verified repository HEAD with git rev-parse. Compared the statements with manuscript section 3 and definitions-and-map.md.
checks.observation: HEAD is 90c03c79bcf44eb8f61dff1b86091b822cc4cd3c. The source gives SF2 caps, an ordinary arbitrary-support I8/I9/I10 proof, P-type support isolation, only five-point core isolation for Q8, B4 separation and universal cap20. The R16 statement expressly assumes size16 and rho <= 7; its maximality argument then supplies separated high-link decompositions at sizes17-20. The source map preserves these guards. This does not replay the imported R16 trees.
checks.scope: Universal prior classifications and their arbitrary-support scope

checks.method: Read pinned paper/main.tex lines 968-1088, including the crowding proof, its exact cross-star guard and the R61 theorem; compared PRIOR_DELTA18_UNLOCK.md and manuscript section 3.
checks.observation: Crowding and R61 explicitly require mu >= 41 and Delta <= 18. The cross-star argument requires both distinct centres outside both tail supports, actual lifted families, intersecting tails and cross-intersection. Its support normalization and resource charging are stated before the finite certificate references. These agree with the current manuscript rather than an unguarded or mu42 transfer. Minimum7 code was not independently inspected in this check.
checks.scope: Guarded prior package used after cap18

checks.method: Read LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md and compared its imported I7 table and six-core shape reduction with pinned main.tex lines 465-529 and 574-611.
checks.observation: The new theorem chooses an actual triple with exactly seven disjoint members, yielding eight complementary members at size15. It imports the universal I7 catalogue and mixed-trace witnesses, then supplies its own H6/H7 and one/two-uv-triple arguments. It explicitly excludes rho <= 6 from its statement. The source map therefore does not silently infer the size15 classification from the prior size16 finite search.
checks.scope: Exact-rho7 source reuse rather than transfer of size16 exhaustion

checks.method: Read LOW15-A3-cover-independent-bridge.md and replay_low15_eight_seven_covers.py. Ran a fresh standard-library script using the eight literal I7 templates, all normalized zero/one/two shared-leaf choices, and direct equality-of-pairwise-intersections sunflower tests; imported no producer or checker.
checks.observation: All 183 normalized gluings were tested. Exactly 13 were SF3 and 170 were rejected. Literal SF3 status agreed in every case with the intersecting point-link criterion. Safe vertices were none for H0,H1,H3,H4,H5, {0} for H2,H6, and {5,6} for H7; admitted counts were 1,1,2,1,1,1,2,4. This confirms the complete gluing domain conditional on the imported I7 classification.
checks.scope: Completeness of the Q8 plus I7 leaf-sharing domain

checks.method: Inspected LOW15-complete-argument.md, LOW15-A3-cover-independent-bridge.md, D16-P8-no-two-cover-exclusion.md and the deletion-first loops in replay_low15_eight_seven_covers.py.
checks.observation: The active code constructs eight separated P8-i2 models and thirteen Q8 gluings, with every deletion set of sizes0,1,2: 1+15+105=121 per model. The upstream P8-i1 exclusion explains removal of eight older models. After deletion, at least13 triples remain and two support points cover at most12, so every ambient four-cover contains a support C3 or equals a P4; global triple codegree2 and simplicity give 2|C3|+|P4| without restricting exterior coincidences. The source enumerates all support triples and four-sets per deletion. I inspected these loops but did not rerun the complete 2541-case cover replay.
checks.scope: Active cover domain and transfer to arbitrary ambient support

checks.method: Read LOW15-direct-Jin-A3-addon.md and compared the manuscript graph argument; a bounded standard-library calculation checked every row of its eight-variable cyclic incidence identity.
checks.observation: The strict threshold is 25*11=275 > 4*68=272. For all eight indices, the three expanded b terms count each a once and a[i] twice. Since neighbourhood preimages are independent even at empty image fibres, b[i] <= 27 precedes surjectivity; sum e=12 yields a[i] >= 13-12=1, after which b[i] >= 25 is justified. The new source map expressly replaces only the older initial k4/empty-fibre argument.
checks.scope: Direct Jin source-map replacement and order of fibre bounds

findings.disposition: The Round 2 manuscript preserves the distinction in sections 3.1 and 7. The new source map does not upgrade shared-builder checks to independent reconstruction or Lean verification. Subsequent row-level inspection remains appropriate.
findings.statement: Shared-builder coefficient replay remains a material implementation dependence separate from mathematical row validity.

findings.disposition: The expanded map identifies the degree2 whole-completion budget, derived eleven-point domain, universal I7 catalogue, Q8 leaf-sharing criterion and cover union bound separately. This round directly tested the Q8 domain and reviewed its exterior transfer; it did not certify all remaining domain implementations.
findings.statement: The finite domains require distinct arbitrary-support bridges; their completeness cannot follow from finite execution alone.

findings.disposition: This is an explained domain narrowing: the active route excludes the eight P8-i1 models upstream and retains eight P8-i2 plus thirteen Q8 models. The excluded-type proof applies under cap16, no-P9 and N[max] <= 45, all stronger than needed once the cap15 route has its stated prerequisites. The manuscript reports the active domain accurately.
findings.statement: The historical cap15 cover notes use 29 models and 3509 cases, whereas the active independent replay uses 21 models and 2541 cases.

revisions.action: Rechecked the assurance language and new obligation table against the inspected bridge and checker source.
revisions.result: The qualification is retained; no prior required revision existed and no independence upgrade is claimed.

revisions.action: Followed the expanded map to the pinned I7/isolation source, Q8 gluing bridge, cover checker and direct Jin add-on.
revisions.result: The separate completeness mechanisms remain explicit. The gluing and cover-transfer mechanisms received additional substantive checks in this round.

content.summary: The inspected source map accurately separates universal imported classifications, new size-15 arguments and active finite domains. Direct inspection of the pinned prior source supports the stated isolation, B4, high-link and guarded-package scopes. A fresh bounded literal check recovered all 13 admissible Q8 gluings from 183 normalized candidates, and the arbitrary-exterior cover transfer is sound as written. No necessary source-map revision was identified; full verification of all certificate rows and proof trees remains beyond this round.
